en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Al Hassan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Is’haq Bin Ammar, said,
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>, ‘Will you<sup>asws</sup> not point me to the one<sup>asws</sup> from whom I should be taking my Religion?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This son<sup>asws</sup> of mine<sup>asws</sup>, Ali<sup>asws</sup>. My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> grabbed me<sup>asws</sup> by my<sup>asws</sup> hand and took me<sup>asws</sup> to the grave of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>!
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [2:30] And when your Lord said to the Angels, I am going to Make a Caliph in the earth
, and surely when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Says (some) Words, He<sup>azwj</sup> Fulfils it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah from al-Hassan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following.
“I said to abu al-Hassan the 1st (a.s.) Would you guide me to a person from whom would learn my religion.”
He said, “This is my son Ali. My father took my hand until we were in the shrine of the Messenger of Allah and said, “My son,
Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, “. . I am appointing someone as my deputy on earth,. .” [2:30]
When Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, says a word He keeps His word.”
